title: The Boring afternoon job
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：boring　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 boring 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the painter wrote of ① a boring afternoon job in the catalogue, and everybody in the studio said at once that it was ② more boring than the one named there the year before. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the painter, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the boring ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most boring afternoon job anybody in the studio had ever seen, or so the catalogue for May 1953 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too boring to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the visitor who had come to help; the boring ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the brush at the far easel, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a boring lecture on Friday, and said that no visitor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as boring as the lecture on Friday they had once had in the old studio. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was boring or not, and he said so.

By 1966 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the catalogue. What the line asked for was ⑦ something boring, and nothing besides. The visitor from the next studio called the whole plan ⑧ quite boring; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the catalogue kept the names of the boring ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1969, with great care, she wrote of another boring afternoon job in the same catalogue, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ more boring than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most boring lecture on Friday in the whole studio, she said in 1971, was the one she could never quite name; the boring ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 乏味（前置定语 a boring afternoon job：1959 年画师在展品目录里记下的那件乏味的活计）
B. adj. 乏味／令人生厌（比较级 more boring than：文中两处，一处比下午的活计，一处比预想）
C. adj. 乏味／令人生厌（最高级 the most boring：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 乏味（表语 too boring to do：母亲觉得它太乏味，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 令人生厌（前置定语 a boring lecture on Friday：叔叔把整件事称作一桩令人生厌的讲座）
F. adj. 令人生厌（同级比较 as boring as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩周五的讲座相比）
G. adj. 令人生厌（后置定语 something boring：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 令人生厌（受程度副词修饰 quite boring：那位观者的评价）

items.q: the most boring afternoon job anybody
The most boring lecture on Friday in

answers.why: boring 意为“乏味”，1959 年画师在展品目录里记下的是“一件乏味的活计”，此处作前置定语 a boring afternoon job。
boring 意为“乏味”，此处用比较级 more boring than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
boring 意为“乏味”，展品目录上 五月 那行字说它是画室里最乏味的一件，故用最高级 the most boring afternoon job。
boring 意为“乏味”，母亲认为这件东西“太乏味了，谁也用不上”，too boring to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
boring 意为“令人生厌”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩令人生厌的讲座”，此处作前置定语 a boring lecture on Friday。
boring 意为“令人生厌”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩周五的讲座一样令人生厌”，同级比较用 as boring as。
boring 意为“令人生厌”，展品目录上那半行字要的是“令人生厌的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something boring。
boring 意为“令人生厌”，邻画室来的那位观者认为这套计划“相当令人生厌”，quite 修饰原级 boring。
boring 意为“令人生厌”，1969 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要令人生厌”，故用比较级 more boring than。
boring 意为“令人生厌”，母亲 1971 年说的是“整个画室里最令人生厌的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most boring lecture on Friday。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1959 年，画师在展品目录里记下了一件乏味的活计。（a boring afternoon job）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更乏味。（more boring than …）
母亲觉得它太乏味，谁也用不上。（too boring to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩令人生厌的讲座。（a boring lecture on Friday）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩周五的讲座一样令人生厌。（as boring as …）
到了 1966 年，展品目录上只剩半行字：要的是一件令人生厌的东西。（something boring）
answers: In 1959 the painter wrote of a boring afternoon job in the catalogue.
Everybody said it was more boring than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too boring to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a boring lecture on Friday.
He said nobody would call it as boring as the lecture on Friday they had once had.
By 1966 the catalogue asked for nothing but something boring.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 boring 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1959 the painter wrote of a boring afternoon job in the catalogue, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most boring afternoon job in the studio, or so the catalogue says.
My mother thought it too boring to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a boring lecture on Friday, and nobody argued with him.
The visitor from the next studio called the plan quite boring, and everybody laughed.
The boring ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
